# store { #labdata.cache.store }

```python
labdata.cache.store(sha, data, root=None)
```

Store an object held in memory.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**sha**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Key to store the object under.

<code>[**data**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bytes](`bytes`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Content to store.

<code>[**root**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Cache root. Defaults to [](`labdata.config.cache_root`).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path of the cached object. An object already present is not rewritten.
